_comment: One entry per skill. codex: ok = no Claude-only tooling, experimental = needs a plugin or tool Codex may lack, claude-only = needs plan mode, session tools or the hook gate. company: true = names Blibli repos, Jira or the iOS app.

skills.name: adit-workflow-plan-enrich
skills.summary: Adds DoD traceability, test cases and a reviewer pass to a draft plan, then saves it.

skills.name: adit-workflow-verify-before-pr
skills.summary: Gate before the PR: lint, build, tests, simulator click tests, design and copy checks.

skills.name: adit-workflow-audit-review-code
skills.summary: Runs an audit loop and a review loop over the current changes and fixes what they find.

skills.name: adit-workflow-generate-plan-from-ticket
skills.summary: Turns a ticket into a reviewed plan with risks and test cases. Never implements.

skills.name: adit-workflow-pr-reply
skills.summary: Triages unresolved PR review threads, fixes the real ones and replies to the rest.

skills.name: adit-workflow-review-pr-blibli-mobile-ios
skills.summary: Batch-reviews open PRs in the iOS repo and remembers what it already reviewed.

skills.name: adit-workflow-check-slot-bliblimobileios
skills.summary: Read-only health table for the three worktree slots.

skills.name: adit-workflow-low-hanging-fruit
skills.summary: Ranks your open IOS tickets from easiest to hardest.

skills.name: adit-workflow-graphify
skills.summary: Builds a knowledge graph of a codebase and answers architecture questions from it.

hooks.summary: Blocks commit, push and PR creation for a ticket until it is verified.
Manages the pool of three worktrees with their own simulators.
